description: Land Title Settlement Dept. Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division Kaluthara District - Cad. Map No 530175 (24/0593)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels in designated locations.
